about_the_game:
Embark on the starting portion of the journey in Our Dreadling's DEMO!

Step into the first portion of the world of our little pink dreadling on its mission to uncover the enigmatic Monono.  Our Dreadling is a minimalist platformer with Metroidvania-style exploration, delivering a blend of dark humor, introspective storytelling, and surreal environments.

This Demo contains the intro to the game and the first playable area.  Access to more areas, boss fights, mini-games and story will be available in the full game!
